# restate_service (Data Source)

A service discovered from a registered deployment, with its effective configuration.

Services are created and destroyed by deployment discovery, never by Terraform. This data source reads one; it does not manage it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Services are created and destroyed by deployment discovery, never by Terraform. This reads one so
# a configuration can depend on what discovery actually found.

data "restate_service" "order_service" {
  name = "OrderService"
}

# Turn a stale service name or a handler that was renamed in the SDK into a plan failure, rather than
# an apply that wires a subscription to a handler that is not there.
check "handle_order_exists" {
  assert {
    condition     = contains(data.restate_service.order_service.handler_names, "handleOrder")
    error_message = "OrderService does not expose handleOrder. Discovery may not have run since the service was renamed."
  }
}

output "service_revision" {
  value = data.restate_service.order_service.revision
}

output "handlers" {
  value = data.restate_service.order_service.handler_names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name to look up, as reported by discovery.

### Read-Only

- `abort_timeout` (String) How long Restate waits after the inactivity timeout before aborting an invocation.
- `deployment_id` (String) Deployment currently serving this service.
- `documentation` (String) Documentation the SDK reported for this service. Empty when it reported none.
- `handler_names` (List of String) Names of the service's handlers. Use `restate_service_handler` for a handler's own configuration.
- `idempotency_retention` (String) How long completed idempotent invocations are retained.
- `inactivity_timeout` (String) How long Restate waits before asking a stalled invocation to suspend.
- `journal_retention` (String) How long invocation journals are retained.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Service metadata reported by discovery.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the service is reachable through the environment's ingress. Null when the API reports nothing.
- `revision` (Number) Current service revision. Discovery increments it when the schema changes.
- `type` (String) Service kind: `Service`, `VirtualObject`, or `Workflow`. Only a `Workflow` supports `workflow_completion_retention`.
- `workflow_completion_retention` (String) How long completed workflow results are retained. Meaningful only for a workflow service.
